description: This file defines a mock API client class 'MockApiClient' used for simulating backend API calls in a Kotlin project. It provides various methods to fetch mock data such as overview statistics, recent activities, donations, volunteers, projects, donor CRM activities, and reports, primarily for testing or development purposes without calling a real backend.

classes.name: MockApiClient
classes.description: A mock-backed API client class that simulates backend REST API calls synchronously for development and testing purposes.

methods.name: simulateLatency
methods.description: Simulates network latency by sleeping for 250 milliseconds.

methods.name: getOverviewStats
methods.description: Returns mock overview statistics including donations month-to-date, active volunteers, projects, and pending tasks.

methods.name: getRecentActivity
methods.description: Provides a list of recent activity items such as donations received, volunteer onboardings, and project updates.

methods.name: listDonations
methods.description: Returns a list of mock donation records with donor details and status.

methods.name: listVolunteers
methods.description: Provides a list of volunteers with regional and contact information.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Returns a list of ongoing and planned mission projects.

methods.name: listDonorCrm
methods.description: Provides a list of donor CRM related activities such as follow-ups and thank-you notes.

methods.name: listReports
methods.description: Returns list of report items with dynamic monthly data.
